hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A circular dial features ten digits from zero through nine positioned consecutively around a wheel.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Moving between digit a and digit b can be done clockwise or counter-clockwise.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: The minimal turns for each step equals min(abs(a - b), 10 - abs(a - b)).

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minRotationsToDial(target: str) -> int:
    curr = 0
    total_rotations = 0

    for ch in target:
        dig = int(ch)
        diff = abs(curr - dig)
        total_rotations += min(diff, 10 - diff)
        curr = dig

    return total_rotations
```

complexity.notes: Single pass accumulates circular shortest distances between consecutive digits.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating full step rotations is redundant given constant circular formula.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies circular distance formula min(d, 10 - d).
